text:
maya: Hey team — Meridian Bank kickoff tomorrow 9:30am. They asked for a 48‑hour POC to validate migration from CompetitorX. Main asks: mapping parity for responses (function/tool calls), pricing for short reserved capacity vs hosted burst, and answers to their security questionnaire (SAML, VPC peering, KMS). cc @jordan @tariq
jordan: Can do a shim. Biggest risk is tool-calling semantics — CompetitorX embeds actions in `choices[].text` sometimes. Need to normalize.
tariq: Agree. We should run a diff harness on ~200 prompts. I can spin up a job. ETA 4 hours.
maya: Also pricing — can we give them a 2-week discounted dedicated trial? They want predictable latencies.
sylvia: From product: dedicated trial ok but need commit to billing policy. I'll draft a 2-week demo PO with credit terms. @maya I'll send draft after meeting.
patrick: Security: they have strict controls. Required items: SAML SCIM, VPC peering, customer KMS, audit logs retention >90d, SOC2 report. We need legal signoff for key management.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire updated — link: https://redwood.example.com/secforms/meridian-2026
jordan: For mapping, propose quick JSON transform: ```json
{
  "competitor_request.prompt": "messages[0].content",
  "competitor_response.choices[0].text": "response.output_text",
  "tool_call_pattern": "^\\[CALL:(.*?)\\]"
}
``` Use prefix detection for tool calls and map to structured tool invocation.
tariq: I started the diff run. Early results: 14% token-level divergence on the long-tail prompts, mostly due to stop-seq handling and sampling temp. We can reduce by pinning temperature and enforcing stop tokens.
maya: Meridian also asked about billing granularity (per-token vs per-request). Sales needs exact numbers for comparison.
sylvia: Quick numbers: hosted API @ $0.015/1k tokens gen, embeddings $0.004/1k. Dedicated — custom pricing, recommend $Xk/mo for their SLAs. I'll get precise quote from finance.
patrick: Legal/enterprise blocker: they require contract clause for data residency + right-to-audit. We have precedent but need legal loop. @maya expect 48-72h.
maya: Cool. For the POC checklist can we cover: 1) shim config, 2) prompt set (200), 3) diff report, 4) security form, 5) trial billing PO? Who owns each?
jordan: I'll own shim + mapping docs.
tariq: I'll own diff harness + run.
sylvia: I'll own pricing PO and product onboarding.
patrick: I'll shepherd security + legal.
maya: Thanks all — I'll update Meridian after the 9:30. Quick note: include a short example of a mapped call in the POC deck. Eventual convo with Infra about VPC peering — @infra-oncall FYI.
infra-oncall: ping received, can provision peering once we have approved IPs and billing code.
maya: :thumbsup: Ok, let's reconvene after the run. Action items tracked in the sales POC doc: https://redwood.example.com/pocs/meridian-1729
